ratio_basis: 1128 complete new horizon-10 starts / (32160 original starts + 1128 new starts); rounded within 2000 samples
new_start_selection: 8-9 starts per successful suffix; at least one per lift, transfer, lower, release and retreat; distribute remainder by eligible stage length; exclude last nine padded-tail-only starts
original_start_selection: Keep B 40/30/30 frame-range weights and all 120 original layout/color episodes; deterministic balanced replacement in the same 2000-start replay schedule used by E
learning_rate_basis: Reuse E/F/G constant rate as a controlled data-content comparison; suffix statistics do not identify an optimal learning rate; no LR sweep authorized
evaluation_proposal: After one segment, compare 48 train development and 75 validation full tasks to retained B records; do not rerun full B; candidate must retain >=72/75 validation and improve relevant held/lift progression on train development; no automatic continuation
limitations: Seven above-5cm held starts and one bilateral table-level grasp
No takeover that starts over the box; cases 105/126 are late transfer states
Only one green recovery and no front-right recovery start
Teacher recoverability is not autonomous-policy success; earlier takeover also preserves more time
